articles.expand: Lane says that if the rise in energy prices persists, maybe it will hit consumption in the autumn but it remains an uncertain issue. Oftentimes, central bankers bake in some weakness in non-energy spending in a price spike but Lagarde this week emphasized the resilience of the economy and consumption.
